title: Lifting PCA in the Wasserstein Space
abstract: arXiv:2610.29679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool for statistical dimension reduction, yet no canonical extension to distribution-valued data has emerged within the framework of optimal transport. While Wasserstein barycenters and Wasserstein least-squares regression provide canonical liftings of Euclidean averaging and linear regression in the Wasserstein space, an analogous principle for PCA has remained unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Lifted PCA, a canonical extension of Euclidean PCA to Wasserstein space, obtained through the framework of lifting functionals in the space of probability measures by convex extension. Starting from the classical variational formulations of PCA on the Stiefel and Grassmann manifolds, we derive two equivalent minimization problems over probability measures supported on these manifolds that correspond to Wasserstein barycenters with generalized costs. translated_abstract: 主成分分析（PCA）是统计降维的基本工具，然而在最优传输的框架下，针对分布值数据的规范化扩展一直未曾出现。虽然Wasserstein重心和Wasserstein最小二乘回归分别为欧氏平均和线性回归在Wasserstein空间中提供了规范化的提升，但PCA的类似原理却始终未被探索。本文提出了提升PCA（Lifted PCA），这是欧氏PCA在Wasserstein空间中的一种规范化扩展，其通过凸延拓提升概率测度空间中泛函的框架获得。从Stiefel流形和Grassmann流形上PCA的经典变分形式出发，我们推导出两个等价的最小化问题，这些问题定义在支撑于上述流形上的概率测度之上，并对应于具有广义代价的Wasserstein重心。我们建立了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了“提升PCA”，通过凸延拓提升泛函的框架，首次将欧氏主成分分析规范化地扩展到Wasserstein空间，并将其归结为两个等价的、具有广义代价的Wasserstein重心最小化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Lifted PCA, the first canonical extension of Euclidean PCA to the Wasserstein space via convex lifting of functionals, formulated as two equivalent Wasserstein barycenter minimization problems with generalized costs.
